note: Pushed to Grafana Cloud by push-alerts.sh on every release. Each rule fires when its log query counts more than 0. The labels come from deploy/alloy/config.alloy.
title: party-quest

rules.title: A Go program panicked
rules.summary: The backend or the relay printed a Go panic. docker compose logs --tail=200 on the instance shows it.

rules.title: The game server hit a script error
rules.summary: Godot printed SCRIPT ERROR. docker compose logs game on the instance shows it.

rules.title: A container restarted after a crash
rules.summary: A process exited and Docker restarted its container. Deploys make new containers, so they don't raise this.
rules.note: The phrase must match server/cmd/api/health.go and deploy/entrypoint.sh.

rules.title: No logs from the backend
rules.summary: 30 minutes without a backend log line, though it logs a heartbeat every 10: the backend, Alloy or the instance has stopped.
rules.note: The window must stay well above the heartbeat in server/cmd/api/health.go. Untuned.
